name: std::exponential_distribution<RealType>::lambda
intro: Returns the λ distribution parameter the distribution was constructed with. The parameter defines the rate of events, per unit. The default value is 1.0.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Floating point value identifying the rate of events per unit.
